proposed_from.topic: Complete signed-monotone counterfactual identification for finite binary semi-Markovian causal diagrams. Given a signed local-monotonicity set M, any finite menu Z of observational/interventional population laws, and any positive-denominator unnested conditional counterfactual query Q, construct a signed order-annotated Ancestral Multi-world Network and canonical order-normal event form; define a terminating M-CTFID procedure that factors order-normal cells over districts and uses ctf-calculus transformations; prove it returns a finite identifying functional iff Q is identified, and otherwise compiles its FAIL trace into two legal finite order-respecting response-type SCMs agreeing on all Z but disagreeing on Q. Replace the ordinary AMWN XOR converse with composable signed isotone threshold gadgets, recover ordinary CTFID when M is empty and all successful M-ID outputs, give the explicit response-type-count termination bound, and add empirical-cell plug-in inference under fixed positive denominators. Use Plecko–Bareinboim's Causal Fairness Analysis toolkit and Maiti's M-ID implementation as consumers.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction, Algorithm 1 and Theorems 1--2, Appendix B.6--B.7, and the conclusion's explicit sufficient-and-necessary open question.
seed_details.anchor_quote: Finding a complete (sufficient and necessary) algorithm for general identification under monotonicity constraints is an important, open research question.
seed_details.kernel: A terminating order-normal district calculus returns a finite semialgebraic menu-law functional if and only if the positive-denominator conditional query is invariant over all compatible signed-monotone SCMs, and otherwise returns two legal finite countermodels.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Replace unrestricted inconsistent-factor or thicket necessity with an order-respecting district obstruction whose countermodels compose across every supplied regime.
seed_details.destination_search: Focused searches for complete monotonicity-aware CTFID, monotone AMWN, and signed response-type identification found M-ID and unrestricted CTFID or CTFIDU plus, but no signed complete calculus.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from M-ID plus finite response-type enumeration because the state space is finite.
seed_details.rebuttal: Enumeration gives a global semialgebraic oracle, not a district-compositional functional, a complete local obstruction, or a trace-to-legal-SCM compiler; the core states the oracle only as a baseline.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The focal object is \(\mathsf{MCTFID}\), not a do-calculus relabeling; success, failure, termination, and two published reductions are all formal deliverables.

seed_details.anchor_location: Lemma 3.3 and Lemmas E.8--E.9, especially pages 28--30 where mod-two sums and a flipped last bit build ctf-hedge and ctf-thicket countermodels; Introduction and Conclusion also read.
seed_details.kernel: Every order-aware terminal thicket admits two finite district-factorized signed-isotone threshold SCMs matching every menu law and separating the target, with support bounded by the signed canonical count.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: The first changed step is the local parity encoding \(V=\bigoplus\operatorname{pa}(V)\), which must be replaced by sign-normalized up-set threshold atoms that remain compatible when thickets share vertices.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for isotone ctf-hedges, monotone thickets, and signed AMWN countermodels returned no construction beyond M-ID's local c-functions and unrestricted parity witnesses.
seed_details.red_team: Impossible in general because monotone Boolean functions cannot simulate XOR and shared thickets need independent separation bits.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection identifies the real open content rather than a refutation: threshold atoms need only preserve the finitely requested menu marginals, not simulate parity pointwise, and the canonical oracle certifies whether a proposed trace is truly separating.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The witness is required uniformly for a finite class of traces with an explicit support bound, not at one hand-tuned law.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction and Conclusion, Theorem 1, and Appendix A.1--A.2 on canonical partitions and finite exogenous cardinalities.
seed_details.kernel: Sharp endpoints for any positive-denominator conditional counterfactual are the extrema of a support-pruned signed-isotone fractional polynomial program, with attainment and singleton collapse exactly at identification.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Restrict each canonical local hypothesis class to Boolean-lattice up-sets before the canonical equivalence proof, then transform the conditional numerator and denominator into a fractional objective.
seed_details.destination_search: ZhangTianBareinboim2022, DuarteEtAl2024, HashimotoKawakamiTian2026, and current monotonicity-bound searches did not supply this arbitrary-diagram and arbitrary-menu signed specialization.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate option filtering inside AutoBounds, with singleton collapse tautological from already-computed endpoints.
seed_details.rebuttal: The signed canonical equivalence and support count are theorem-level, but the objection limits the standalone tier; the bound program is retained as the oracle and fallback layer of the stronger calculus rather than the headline.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The proposal does not ship this as an LP-only headline; it is paired with the complete graphical certificate and inference layers.

seed_details.anchor_location: Theorem 1 and Appendix A.2 finite canonical reduction, plus the Introduction and Conclusion.
seed_details.kernel: Decide signed-monotone identification by quantifier elimination over canonical response-type masses and extract algebraic countermodels.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Replace unrestricted response functions by signed-isotone types and express fiber constancy as a first-order real sentence.
seed_details.destination_search: General polynomial optimizers occupy the computational substrate, although no paper states this exact signed conditional decision theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the canonical finite-SCM theorem and Tarski--Seidenberg quantifier elimination.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the basic existence result, so the seed is dropped as a headline and retained only as a baseline theorem.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Dropped because it would mistake decidability for the requested graphical calculus.

seed_details.anchor_location: Empirical Sections 4.1--4.2, the absence of a general limit theorem, and the Conclusion; Introduction and Algorithm 1 also read.
seed_details.kernel: Quotient population-equivalent order-normal derivations into one canonical functional and derive its Gaussian or directional-Gaussian limit together with a derivative-aware bootstrap that remains valid at empirical branch ties.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Before differentiating the multi-regime expression, prove canonical equivalence of competing calculus traces and estimate the active directional derivative at ties rather than applying an ordinary smooth delta method to one selected trace.
seed_details.destination_search: BhattacharyaNabiShpitser2022 covers ordinary effect formulas and directional-delta work covers generic kinks, but searches found no representation-invariant compiler for competing signed conditional counterfactual derivations.
seed_details.red_team: A routine multivariate delta method once one successful formula is fixed.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed concerns the non-fixed case: equivalent derivations may select different active algebraic branches at a tie, so representation invariance and consistent directional-derivative estimation are additional theorem obligations.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The named focal object is the canonical quotient map and its tie-aware derivative, not a generic plug-in central limit theorem.

seed_details.kernel: Enumerate all inclusion-minimal signed edge sets and data menus identifying each finite binary Fairness Map contrast, with countermodels for every omitted condition.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Unnest each direct, indirect, spurious, and conditioned contrast while retaining its factual event, then solve the signed identification problem across the assumption lattice.
seed_details.destination_search: The Fairness monograph and MaitiPleckoBareinboim2025 provide the query family and selected formulas, but no minimal full frontier.

seed_details.kernel: Augment AMWNs with signed parent-order labels and derive a complete graphical criterion for cross-world stochastic inequalities implied by local monotonicity.

proposed_from.literature_map: The chosen seed was checked against four adjacent completeness threads and three computational or consumer threads. MaitiPleckoBareinboim2025, Introduction, Algorithm 1, Theorems 1--2, Appendix B.6--B.7, and Conclusion, settles sound local reduction but explicitly leaves general necessity and sufficiency open. CorreaLeeBareinboim2021, Theorems 3--6 and Conclusion, settles unrestricted district factorization and complete conditional CTFID for arbitrary observational and interventional menus. CorreaBareinboim2025, Theorems 2.5 and 3.1--3.2, settles unrestricted AMWN independence and ctf-calculus completeness without signed order labels. RaghavanBareinboim2026, Lemma 3.3 and Lemmas E.8--E.9, supplies the closest failure compiler, but its mod-two and flipped-bit mechanisms violate isotonicity. ZhangTianBareinboim2022, Theorem 1 and Appendix A.1--A.2, settles unrestricted finite canonical equivalence and makes the signed Dedekind restriction possible. LeeCorreaBareinboim2020 and ShpitserPearl2008 show how thickets and parity witnesses establish unrestricted necessity. DuarteEtAl2024 supplies a global polynomial oracle rather than a graphical calculus. BhattacharyaNabiShpitser2022 supplies an identification-to-estimation compiler for ordinary effects. PleckoBareinboim2024 supplies the Fairness Map consumer. HashimotoKawakamiTian2026 is a recent monotonicity LP paper for a narrower single-treatment ordinal target and does not subsume the kernel. Focused searches through August 28, 2026 found no complete signed-monotone CTFID calculus, no order-respecting ctf-thicket compiler, and no arbitrary-menu signed conditional result closer than these papers.

banked_reason: The district-compositional signed order-AMWN/ctf-calculus with a terminal local-trace compiler was not delivered; the sound global QE/CAD oracle achieved only subfield tier.
